name: DEEP DIVE – Can you set the record?
description:
Limited oxygen. Infinite depth. Can you set the record?

You wake up on a tiny deserted island with nothing but the ocean around you. Grab your gear, take a deep breath and dive.

Down there, oxygen is everything. Your air runs out fast, so you'll be hunting for hidden air pockets and abandoned tanks just to stay alive. The first five levels have glowing trails to help you learn the ropes. After that you're on your own. A 4-digit PIN gate stands between you and the real deep, and once you crack it the ocean never ends. Every level gets darker, the air gets scarcer and the monsters get nastier.

How deep can you go? The top 10 leaderboard ranks divers by level and time, so every second counts. Captain Finn will get you started, but the record is up to you.

Play on Bedrock (arrowwars.dk, port 10015). Java players: arrowwars.dk
